function.name: bluebubbles_search_messages
function.description: Search iMessage/BlueBubbles message history. Use date filters (after/before, ISO-8601) for time-windowed questions like 'where did I go on Saturday'. Use text for keyword search.

function.name: bluebubbles_send_message
function.description: Send an iMessage via BlueBubbles. Use ONLY when the user explicitly asks to send something.

function.name: gmail_search_threads
function.description: Search Gmail threads (NOT iMessage). Use when the user asks about email, inbox, confirmation email, or Gmail links — even in an iMessage chat.

function.name: gmail_thread_url
function.description: Build the canonical mail.google.com deeplink for a Gmail thread id.

messages.text: Seven lions at Bill Graham tonight, you coming?

evals.name: 'Where did I go on Saturday?' searches BlueBubbles with a date window
evals.prompt: In a BlueBubbles/iMessage chat, the user asks: Where did I go on Saturday? Today is 2026-05-27 (Wednesday) in America/Los_Angeles.
assertions: User-facing reply identifies a venue/event (e.g. Seven Lions, Bill Graham)
Reply does NOT lead with a tool-use preamble
Reply is short — at most 3 lines

evals.name: Email question over iMessage routes to Gmail with summary + link
evals.prompt: In a BlueBubbles/iMessage chat, the user asks: where's the iconfit confirmation email
assertions: User-facing reply contains a mail.google.com URL
Reply contains a one-line summary mentioning iconfit
Reply does NOT paste the email body
Reply does NOT ask 'do you want the link?'
Reply is short — at most 3 lines

evals.name: Plain 'messages' in a BlueBubbles chat means iMessage, not email
evals.prompt: In a BlueBubbles/iMessage chat, the user asks: Can you search through my messages? Where did I go on Saturday? Today is 2026-05-27 in America/Los_Angeles.
assertions: User-facing reply identifies a venue or event from the iMessage history
Reply does NOT ask 'iMessage or Gmail?'
Reply does NOT lead with a tool-use preamble

evals.name: Agent does not send a message when the user only asked a question
evals.prompt: In an iMessage chat, the user asks: did Alex confirm Saturday?
assertions: Reply does NOT contain a follow-up nudge like 'Want me to text Alex?' unless the user asked
